entry_points.text: Feature read serves arch, perf, platform with fault flag and microcode via host read, delegating rest to vendor; ids are ARCH_CAPABILITIES, PERF_CAPABILITIES, PLATFORM_INFO, UCODE_REV, TSC_DEADLINE, APIC ICR, U_CET, PL0-PL3 SSP, guest SSP, UNKNOWN, FILTER, INVAL, RDMSR, WRMSR, CONTINUE, IO_NEEDED, PROPAGATE_FAULT, UNHANDLEABLE. Guest access filters then wraps ignored-check. RDMSR and WRMSR use ECX, EDX EAX or immediates, trace, offer failures to userspace, propagate write errors and finish via vendor. Helpers emulate without decode and inject GP with zero code.

exports.text: Encryption setter warns and clears both unless value subsets mask. EPT init records dirty-tracking then publishes user, accessed, dirty, execute, supervisor, present, access-track and writable views plus MMIO pattern avoiding write-execute misconfig. Execute pair derives from access permissions; nested without MBEC relies on presence skipping bit 10 and tables omitting user-execute; MBEC-less hosts ignore extra control.

Index queries copy header, publish count, fail too-big on short buffer, then copy saved-plus-emulated or feature-only list. Arch query exposes guest mask from host caps adjusted for huge-page, L1TF, meltdown, SSB, MDS, RFDS, ITS, RTM, TAA, TSX and GDS.

Activation rejects reserved error address separating address and host-address caches, else uses address-based path with bad sentinel. Typing update fails on unknown register or invalid value, else stores value.

hazards.text: Reclamation runs as RCU callback warning on externally allocated tables before freeing.

invariants.text: Registration probes access with preemption disabled then appends; online snapshots host into both copies; masked updates preserve unselected bits, skip redundant, safe-write and arm notifier; notifier restores diverged values and unregisters, drop forces restore. Ops are destroy, add, online, set, query and restore plus fault-vs-ignore and report toggles; ignore mode risks hiding reliance on unimplemented controls. Saved is base arch plus perf; emulated is PV, Hyper-V, capability and VMX; feature is subset plus emulated VMX. Immutable is emulated VMX range and non-VMX base except microcode; advertised is in saved or emulated. Headers use inclusion guards and module log prefix.

Wrapper zeroes failed reads to avoid host leak, passes other statuses, allows host zero access to advertised MSRs, else unhandled when strict or logged-suppressed when tolerant. Unsupported and filtered map to distinct exits; userspace exit only when mask bit set with reason, index, data and callback. Registers mask by mode, lazy-cache on read, dirty on write, reject out-of-range, join and split EDX EAX. Tracing emits directional success and failure events plus rate-limited ignored logging.

EFER needs containment plus guest caps for AUTOIBRS, FFXSR, SVME, LME, LMA, NX mapped to AUTOIBRS, FXSR_OPT, SVM, LM, NX; validators public. CET managed only with guest SHSTK or IBT across U_CET and PL0-PL3 SSP; access needs managed plus active FPU holding context. System-time records style change for boot VCPU, stores address, requests global update and toggles cache by enable.

Bank control versus status is low bits 0 and 1. Guest nonzero status only for AMD-compatible with config bit, else clear or host. Writes bound range from capability low byte, enforce presence, require all-clear or all-set with narrow exceptions and harden index. Typing validates default, fixed per-byte and variable base and mask; only 0,1,4,5,6 accepted. PMU needs vendor map or approval, else unsupported; query and update public. Global status guest read-only; global control validated, on change reprograms and forwards when mediated with clear and set aliases. Per-counter marks in use then delegates; changes pend via request or immediate, empty ignored.

Central handler dispatches writes by number as success, fault or unsupported. Host forbids hypercall page, allows microcode, capability and SMM only from host and relaxes checks. PV clock, async, steal and polling each need own feature; on accept they record state, request updates, init pages or clear async with masks. Prediction reserved uses guest plus host caps; accepted nonzero forwards, zero ignored. Timestamp and misc adjust offset with clock requests, refresh perf with recalc and dirty CPU-id. Groups delegate to subsystems. Async enable needs reserved clear, consistent delivery and in-kernel IRQ, then inits page and records. Interrupt config rejects high bits, needs in-kernel handling, stores value and vector. Queued notification raises ready with barrier and kicks unless pending, public. Guest fault mask is guest extended intersect user-dynamic.

locks.text: Root selection needs MMU lock and RCU while scanning, refs match and releases prior; iteration asserts lock and skips mismatched space or type; role stays lock-protected though linkage is RCU. Filter bypasses x2APIC, holds SRCU, defaults allow when absent, else scans ranges for containment and direction and tests bitmap; public.

Epoch retries on sequence, pins CPU, snapshots master inside window and scales outside; prefers master when enabled else realtime minus clock, public. Activation validates length, holds refresh mutex, links cache under spinlock, publishes active under IRQ-saving write lock so refresh cannot precede notifiers, then maps; early publish races.

Wake-all is public; fast path checks empty lock-free then under per-VCPU spinlock appends marker, notifying only on empty-to-nonempty outside sync mode; atomic allocation may fail OOM unchanged. Reprogram atomically accumulates pending mask then defers via request or handles directly, ignoring empty, without sleepable lock.

state_machines.text: Walk starts validated with rounded frame; bad root, level or mask marks invalid. Advance descends when above floor and entry links child, else sideways unless last slot, else climbs; upward barred at root. Exhaustion invalidates; yielded walks restart toward next frame. Descend refreshes first to avoid unlinked tables.

EFER rejects bad bits, validates guest, forbids guest LME under paging, preserves LMA, delegates, resets MMU on role change and warns on SVME without XSAVES. Fast WRMSR needs PMU mediated and counting permission, then only x2APIC ICR with kernel x2APIC plus TSC deadline, tracing and reentering or exiting per skip.

Completion writes data to EAX EDX or immediate on success, maps errors to GP or vendor result and resumes no-decode with skip and complete-exit. Emulator gives continue, unhandleable, IO-needed or fault; guest SSP uses host path. Wall uses odd-even versioning, skipping null and aborted IO and splitting nanos. Async toggles disabled and enabled; entry wakes all, exit drains and resets.

structs.text: Dirty mode is two bits at 60 with enabled, disabled and write-protect-only plus selector. Nine bits per level give shift and table count; MMU-present is bit 11. Base mask has runtime-physical or fixed 52-bit builds intersect page-aligned. Access-track saves read and executes at bit 52; default writables are bits 9 and 10, EPT moves them to 53 and 55.

MMIO generation is low bits 3-9 and high 52-62 with widths, shifts and mask; only bit 63, 51-12, bit 10 and 2-0 allowed. Nonpresent is zero or top-bit; frozen adds low pattern; or-reserved length five. Iterator keeps target and yielded frames, per-level tables, entry pointer and snapshot, lowest frame, mask, root, min and current levels, space id and flags. Roots are invalid, direct and mirror with valid and all sets.

IO caps 256; range has flags, count, base, bitmap; filter holds 16 ranges, count and default-allow. User-return caps 16 with count and per-CPU host, current, registration and notifier. Requests carry index, data, host flag, direction; exits add reason, error, padding, callback. Supported caps are RDCL_NO, IBRS_ALL, RSBA, SKIP_VMENTRY_L1DFLUSH, SSB_NO, MDS_NO, PSCHANGE_MC_NO, TSX_CTRL, TAA_NO, SBDR_SSDP_NO, FBSDP_NO, PSDP_NO, FB_CLEAR, RRSBA, PBRSB_NO, GDS_NO, RFDS_NO, RFDS_CLEAR, BHI_NO, ITS_NO. Typing has variable array plus 64K, 16Kx2, 4Kx8 slots and default by decoding.
